title: Say Ag-iilaloan a Panagpakan na Matatken
intro: Diad sagradon pasen na Abung nen Allah, sakey a masiken lan lingkor na Dios so akaeksperiensya na sakey a misteryo ya ag nailaloan. Sayan debosyonadon indibidual, ya abayag lan linmabas ed saray taon na natural ya inka-ateng, et akatasi na sakey a bengatlan nikadkaduman mangipapatnag na andi-anggaan a panangasi na Dios. Say puzzle et diad pangiparungtal ed sayan alingwanan lan bekta manlapud bilay na saray propeta.
clues: Saray totook et kabkabat bilang Israel, saray kabyangay boleg na sakey a baleg a patriarka nen saman.
Manpipikasi ak ed labi, ya ontalimukor ak ed arap na Katawan ko diad templo.
Naikdan ak na anak a laki nen masiken ak la, sakey a regalo ya agkon balot tinmundan igloria si Allah.
Say bista ko et say pakadiskobre na sustento ya ompatnag parad sakey a malangwer nin kamarerwa ya walad panangasikasok.
Sakey ak a propeta ya manngaran na Zakariyya, ya inikdan na kimey ya mangasikaso ed si Maryam diad Bayt al-Maqdis.
Say ebat et walad bersikulo ya inawat nen Allah si Maryam tan inikdan toy naakan to.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say propita ya angasikaso ed si Maryam diad templo
Say propita ya angipaalagey na sagradon abung
Say propeta et inakmon na baleg a sira
Say propita ya binmatik ed saray totoo to
Say propita ya direktan akitongtong ed si Allah
identity.answer: Say propita ya angasikaso ed si Maryam diad templo

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Nasubok ed dakel a taon ya kelang
Say pananap na naakan ya misteryoson intarya parad sakey a malangwer nin ward
Say pampulong ed sakey a nasyon ya angipulisay ed panangiwanwan na Dios
Say pangibantak ed abot na saray totoo to
Pakaawat na panangiparungtal panamegley na pasingawey
trial.answer: Say pananap na naakan ya misteryoson intarya parad sakey a malangwer nin ward

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a barkon ginawa manlapud tabla tan pako
Say sagradon templo na Jerusalem
Sakey a hardin ya aderal
Sakey a syudad ya impaalagey na matunong ya ari
Say kaaralem na dayat

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Anisia iray totoo tan tinmumbok ira ed samay imbaki
Say madibinon panangawat tan panangasi parad saramay debosyonado ed panagdayew
Say dusa et sinmabi ed saray ag mananisia
Sakey a laki so nianak ed inkatatken unong ed insipan
Maligen a dalan ed kalawakan
outcome.answer: Say madibinon panangawat tan panangasi parad saramay debosyonado ed panagdayew

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
